scripts.format:check: prettier --check README.md package.json tsconfig*.json src test-fixtures
scripts.prebuild: node --eval "import('node:fs/promises').then(({ rm }) => rm('dist', { force: true, recursive: true }))"
scripts.prebuild:test-fixtures: node --eval "import('node:fs/promises').then(({ rm }) => rm('dist-fixtures', { force: true, recursive: true }))"
scripts.posttest: node --eval "import('node:fs/promises').then(({ rm }) => rm('dist-fixtures', { force: true, recursive: true }))"
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:test-fixtures && vitest run src
